selection_reason: Unused full-season-shaped league dataset selected from coverage before player events; one expected fixture is absent and will remain explicitly missing.
pattern_A: Existing frozen original environment-first 2+ shots rule.
pattern_B: Pattern A plus previous-five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.

betting_policy.rollover_method: Sort selections by kickoff, fixture ID and player ID; partition into consecutive non-overlapping blocks of the stated length. Start each block with $10 and roll the entire return through every leg. Any loss returns $0. Ignore and count an incomplete final block.
betting_policy.same_kickoff_warning: The deterministic ordering can put simultaneous selections in one block, so rollover output is a mathematical selection-order simulation, not a claim that every block was executable live.

decision_policy: No threshold, odds, rollover length, ordering or exclusion changes after player-event acquisition. Preserve all samples and losing blocks.
limits: One expected league fixture is absent; missing data will not be invented.
Women's football and the same StatsBomb provider family do not directly validate men's MLS.
Fixed odds are user-supplied hypothetical prices, not archived market odds.
No commission, limits, voids, timing constraints or bookmaker settlement differences are modelled.
